title: Hurricane Ida Response: Corps of Engineers installs 20,000th blue roof after Hurricane Ida
description:
The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers commemorates the 20,000th Hurricane Ida blue roof installation at home of Houma, Louisiana resident Mable Lyons, Oct. 8, 2021.

Interview of: Mable Ann Lyons
keywords: FEMA, Hurricane Ida, Ida, Blue Roof, USACE
unit_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Los Angeles District
